definitions.explanation: Describes a person or manner that tends to hold back, be restrained, or avoid imposing on others. Conveys a habitual tendency toward reserve rather than a single instance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新入社員|しんにゅうしゃいん}→新入社員：15536_shinnyuushain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遠慮|えんりょ}がちな⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}していた→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧。
examples.english: The new employee attended the meeting with a reserved attitude.

examples.japanese: {遠慮|えんりょ}がちな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{言|い}えない→言う：00515_iu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Because of my reserved personality, I sometimes have trouble speaking up with my own opinions.

notes:
USAGE:
The suffix がち indicates a tendency or inclination. Can be used as a な-adjective ({遠慮|えんりょ}がちな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧) or adverbially ({遠慮|えんりょ}がち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧). The がち suffix attaches to many other words to express habitual tendencies, such as ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧がち (sickly) and ⟦{怠|なま}け→怠ける：02379_namakeru⟧がち (tending to be lazy).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遠慮|えんりょ}がちな⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (a reserved attitude)
- {遠慮|えんりょ}がちな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (a diffident personality)
- {遠慮|えんりょ}がち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ (to speak hesitantly)
- {遠慮|えんりょ}がち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧ (to smile shyly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{控|ひか}えめ→控えめ：17234_hikaeme⟧: modest, restrained — suggests deliberate restraint, often seen as a positive trait
- ⟦{内気|うちき}→内気：16836_uchiki⟧: shy, introverted — describes an inherent personality trait rather than a behavioral tendency
